title: OAuthProviderWriteRequest

client_secret.description: Encrypted at rest and never returned by API.

auto_provision.description: Enable first-login user creation for allowed OAuth identities.

default_role_ids.description: Required when auto_provision is true. Server requires roles.assign for this field.

redirect_uri.description: Must match AUTOSTREAM_PUBLIC_URL scheme/host in production. Supported paths are /auth/oauth/callback for login providers and /integrations/oauth-accounts/callback for Google connected accounts.

description: For /integrations/oauth-accounts/callback, provider_type must be google, auto_provision/default_role_ids are not allowed, and scopes must include a Google Drive or YouTube API scope.
